parsed.rationale_overall: System A directly answers the user's year-by-year glide path query with a complete 11-year allocation table, more specific dollar amounts, and adds a tax-optimization recommendation tailored to the user's $88K surplus and catch-up eligibility. System B has internal inconsistencies (Rec #1 summary says 'reduce equity to 70%' which is an increase from current 55%, and the action contradicts the target) and defers the bond ladder to year 7 without giving a complete year-by-year schedule as clearly as A.
